description: Evidence-bound e-billing audit engine that reviews invoices against all supplied matter records, makes only provable corrections, and returns a confidence-scored audit trail.

defaultPrompt: Run a complete e-billing audit on my invoice package and create a corrected copy.
Identify only edits supported by the documents, and flag every unresolved item.
Provide a confidence-scored audit log that my lawyers can review quickly.
interface.longDescription: A full e-billing audit workflow for legal invoices. It compares time entries, rates, expenses, budgets, engagement terms, client and outside counsel guidelines, prior invoices, matter activity, staffing rules, UTBMS codes, adjustments, and matter status when those records are supplied. It makes only corrections directly supported by an explicit rule and documentary evidence, preserves all originals, and produces a confidence-scored audit trail for lawyer review.

name: matter-prebill-compliance
